title: Do not split a Check criterion phrase starting with a dash flag into a runnable Check row

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-182242-2e66, project ork, item S572:

Do not split a Check criterion phrase starting with a dash flag into a runnable Check row

Evidence: round 2 slice check row "$ --questions" -> "not run by ork: not a command (starts with -)", taken from the Acceptance criteria line, not a command
